_about: Options: Show Outgrow garden outlines (OutgrowDebugOverlaySystem): every outgrown garden drawn on the city as its last plan wrote it, a dot at every corner, edges under 2 m red, the lot white. Loads 'PM Askew Corner' (outgrow-askew-make.json), plans every garden again and pictures the corner and the two curves cases with the outlines on.
